anchor: v3::Grace Odhiambo, ORD-20768. The leather hiking boots are half a size too small. Can I exchange them?

result.text: Yes, Grace, the boots are eligible for an exchange. They were delivered 11 days ago, which is within the 30-day exchange window, and there's no restocking fee. What size would you like instead? Once you confirm, I'll start the exchange return, and the replacement ships after the return is scanned. If the exchange doesn't go through, the refund would be $159 to your original payment method within 5–7 business days after the warehouse receives the item.

results.title: Exchanges
results.body: Footwear and apparel can be exchanged for a different size or color within 30 days of delivery at no cost. To exchange, start a return with reason "wrong_size" and place a new order; the replacement ships once the return is scanned.

results.title: Final sale
results.body: Items marked final sale (clearance) cannot be returned or exchanged. They are still covered by the warranty against manufacturing defects.

results.title: Refunds
results.body: Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5-7 business days after the returned item is received at the warehouse. Restocking fees, when they apply, are deducted from the refund.

results.title: Returns
results.body: Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Opened electronics have a shorter window (see "Opened electronics"). Final-sale items cannot be returned. Always confirm eligibility for the specific order before starting a return.

results.title: Opened electronics
results.body: Opened electronics (headphones, GPS units, headlamps, action cameras, watches) can be returned within 14 days of delivery. A 15% restocking fee is deducted from the refund. After 14 days, opened electronics are covered by warranty only.
